subject.title: feat(memorySearch): Support multimodal embedding with gemini-embedding-2-preview

question: Should OpenClaw expand memory search beyond opt-in extraPaths image/audio into remembered attachments plus PDF/video, and what consent, retention, deletion, provider-upload, and reindexing contract should gate that behavior?
rationale: The missing behavior is feasible in the current memory/Gemini path, but it changes durable memory and remote upload handling for raw user media, which needs maintainer product/security intent.

options.title: Design gated media memory first
options.body: Define supported modalities, opt-in consent, storage/retention/deletion behavior, provider limits, and reindexing before accepting implementation.

options.title: Keep the shipped subset
options.body: Leave core at image/audio extraPaths only and require users to summarize or place media manually until there is stronger owner-sponsored demand.

options.title: Expand extraPaths only
options.body: Add PDF/video files under extraPaths while explicitly excluding chat-attachment retention from the first follow-up.

recommendation.title: Design gated media memory first
recommendation.body: Define supported modalities, opt-in consent, storage/retention/deletion behavior, provider limits, and reindexing before accepting implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision lands closest to the shipped multimodal memory subset and its config/docs boundary.
